messages:
Priya Rao: Handoff to nightshift — stepping off in 10. Active incident INC-2028 affecting eu-west inference pool. Primary for the night: @Ethan Kim. Secondary: @Olivia Park. Quick brief :wave:

Priya Rao: TL;DR: since ~15:40 UTC p95 gen latency jumped from ~180ms to ~1.2s for model-redwood/gpt-small. Error rate up from ~0.5% to ~3% (502s / timeouts). Traffic skewed toward eu-west-2. Customers impacted (Dedicated): AcmeTiles, MonolithAI.

incident-bot: INC-2028 created · severity S2 · pager routed to Ethan Kim.

Priya Rao: Mitigations already in flight:
- scaled eu-west-2 dedicated pool +2 nodes (Marco executed).
- enabled fallback routing to `model-redwood/gpt-small-v2` in us-central for new sessions.
- warming KV cache for top prefixes.
Runbook: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/latency-spikes

Marco Diaz: Confirmed scale command ran: `infra scale --pool eu-west-2 --add 2 --reason 'latency spike'`. New nodes booted ~2m ago, currently warming.

Ethan Kim: Oncall ack. Investigating logs/kernels. Early signal: one GPU node (gpu-02) showing repeated restarts and long GC pauses. Running: `ssh gpu-02 && journalctl -u inference --since '10m' | tail -n 200`.

ops-bot: Alert · gpu-02 reported 3 restarts in 8m.

Olivia Park: If gpu-02 is flapping we should cordon+drain it. Runbook suggests: `k8s cordon gpu-02 && k8s drain gpu-02 --ignore-daemonsets --timeout=600s`.

Ethan Kim: Agree. Starting cordon/drain now. Also setting autoscale lock so cluster doesn't shrink: `infra autoscale --pool eu-west-2 --min 4 --max 12 --lock 30m`.

Priya Rao: Customer comms: CS has been notified for AcmeTiles (#4521) and MonolithAI (#4522). They reported elevated latencies/errors but no data loss. Please cc support if you send follow-ups.

Marco Diaz: Drain initiated. Rebalancing ~120 active streams; expect transient latency increase for migrated streams.

Ethan Kim: Drain completed. gpu-02 cordoned and drained. Observed repeated CUDA driver timeouts in kernel logs — filing infra ticket INFRA-891 for hardware replacement.

Olivia Park: Pushed a temporary routing policy to bias new sessions away from eu-west-2 for 5m: `routing set --region eu-west-2 --prefer us-central --duration 5m`.

ops-bot: Metric snapshot attached to incident: https://observability.redwood/INC-2028/metrics

Priya Rao: Current impact summary: partial degraded latency for eu-west traffic. p95 settled ~800ms, error rate down to ~0.9%. Mitigations reduced customer error surface.

Priya Rao: Ownership & next steps: Ethan owns incident until 03:00 UTC (primary). Olivia is backup and on-call for escalation. Marco to follow infra ticket and coordinate hardware swap. I'll do a management update at 02:30 UTC.

Ethan Kim: Will collect kernel trace/dump now: `inference-dump --node gpu-02 --out /tmp/gpu-02-dump.tar` and upload to the incident folder. Also running extended profiler to check for memory fragmentation.

Olivia Park: I'll monitor customer-facing error dashboards and update CS if anything regresses. If errors >2% or p95 >1.5s for 10m, escalate to SRE Lead (Leah) and post to #exec-ops.

Priya Rao: Coverage note: after Ethan's shift ends at 03:00 UTC there's a 30m gap before daytime primary (Naomi) signs in. Olivia — can you cover 03:00–03:30?

Olivia Park: I can cover 03:00–03:30, adding myself to the rotation for that window.

Ethan Kim: Uploaded dump & traces to incident bucket. I'll also add a sticky summary to the runbook under INC-2028 with exact mitigation steps and results.

Marco Diaz: INFRA-891 created and assigned to @Jin. ETA for hardware swap 6–8 hours (will update if expedited).

Priya Rao: Outstanding TODOs (short list):
- Ethan: verify latency stays steady for 15m post-drain + attach traces.
- Ethan: confirm autoscale lock and pool stabilization.
- Marco: follow up on INFRA-891 and schedule swap.
- Olivia: keep CS updated, monitor errors.

Ethan Kim: Noted. I'll keep this thread updated. If any regression, escalate immediately.

Olivia Park: I'll ping CS at +30m with status.

Priya Rao: Thanks team — handing off. If critical, call my phone. :phone: 

ops-bot: Handoff recorded by Priya Rao. Next oncall: Ethan Kim (primary), Olivia Park (secondary).
